leadText:
Bonitaville (Japanese: ブロウタウン Blow Town) is an -exclusive town in Johto. It is located between Goldenrod City and Ecruteak City. The town hosts the annual Pokémon Beauty Contest.

Following on 's insistence, arrived in Bonitaville and met up with Suzie, from which Brock got his . Brock and Suzie decided to compete in the Pokémon Beauty Contest as a couple with Vulpix. Another and a friend of Suzie's, Zane, also entered the contest with his . After the contest, Brock returned Vulpix to Suzie.
